semantic_roundtrip.remaining_semantic_delta: This is a derived sufficient-condition producer, not the full numbered source theorem. Regularizer-supplied curvature and convex component losses are stronger than assuming curvature of the total objective in Lemma7.5/7.47/15.31. Algorithm15.9 already prints a common-domain condition; common finiteness is a restriction relative to broader extended-real Algorithm7.1 branches, not a newly discovered omission there. Algorithm7.1 has psi:X to R with V subset X, while Corollary7.6 uses psi:V to R; arbitrary real extension outside V has no effect after the indicator. The below-top domain condition alone admits bottom; separate global no-bottom makes the included losses finite on V and prevents mixed-infinity addition. Zero n and zero lambda are allowed. No minimizer, support, finite-dimensionality, strict curvature, closedness or attainment is assumed or produced.
